item.title: Welsch Poked Studio Bets On Original IP With Gritty Sci-Fi Short ‘Pokedbots – Delta City’
item.description: The Welsh studio’s first original IP blends dystopian world-building, lean production, and a digital-first approach to original CG animation.

item.title: Adobe Ends Animate, Abandoning Millions Of Artists Amid AI Push
item.description: The sudden shutdown ends decades of workflows, jeopardizes active productions, and deepens fears that AI-first strategies are steering the industry.

item.title: Josh D’Amaro To Replace Bob Iger As CEO Of The Walt Disney Company
item.description: D'Amaro will take over for outgoing boss Bob Iger on March 18, with Dana Walden also set for a promotion to president and chief creative officer.

item.title: Scratches, Ghost Noise, And 195 Million Views: The Retro Animation of Kazuya Kanehisa
item.description: From VHS scars to Showa-era rhythms, the self-taught animator revives lost media textures, turning retro decay into videos with hundreds of millions of views.

item.title: Adobe U-Turns, Says Animate Will Remain In The Subscription-Based Creative Cloud, But With No Future Updates Or Innovation
item.description: Adobe confirms Animate will stay in Creative Cloud, receiving only "security and bug fixes, but will not get new features," as all development has ended.

item.title: Octavio Rodriguez’s Eco-Minded Feature ‘On The Edge’ Targets 2027 Release, Fills Out Cast
item.description: 'On The Edge' originated at Studio BlueGreen, a not-for-profit animation studio using entertainment to strengthen audience connections with nature.

item.title: WIA Names Hayley Porter As Its First Executive Director
item.description: A 25-year industry veteran, Porter has led global campaigns, advised top studios, and worked on the Oscar-winning short 'War is Over!'

item.title: ‘Miraculous’ Studio Zag Appoints Rémi Guerin As Head of Studio
item.description: The veteran executive joins the company in a newly created role overseeing production, creative operations, and talent management.

item.title: Your Tax Dollars At Work: Senators Sidestep Antitrust Questions To Scold Netflix Over ‘Woke’ Content
item.description: Ted Sarandos defended Netflix’s Warner Bros. deal in a Senate hearing that quickly devolved from legitimate antitrust scrutiny to culture war theatrics.

item.title: GKIDS Brings ‘Macross’ Creator Shoji Kawamori’s First Original Feature ‘Labyrinth’ To U.S. Theaters
item.description: GKIDS sets a limited release for May 10 and 11 for Shoji Kawamori’s original sci-fi feature, blending pop music, online identity, and social commentary.
